name: hms
description: Home Management System - a family operating system for the household

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hms/shared && npm run build -w @hms/api && npm run build -w @hms/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @hms/api & npm run dev -w @hms/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hms/shared && npm run test -w @hms/api && npm run test -w @hms/web
